patch_description: Crossover of the current adaptive-R Kalman/RTS smoother (combined 0.69) with the static-R variant (combined 0.68). The static-R version achieves better noise reduction (0.63 vs 0.59) and correlation, while the adaptive-R version achieves better smoothness (0.42 vs 0.39), fewer slope changes and false reversals. The crossover keeps the adaptive innovation-based measurement noise from the current program but blends it more strongly toward the robust static MAD estimate (0.7*R0 + 0.3*EWMA, slower EWMA λ=0.95), preserving stability of the smoother while still widening R during noise bursts. The second (refinement) RTS pass reverts to the static R from the inspiration program, since the refined input is already denoised and a static R there yielded better noise reduction and accuracy. All other components (adaptive Q from local acceleration, two-pass RTS, zero-phase bilateral one-pole ripple damper, output contract) are preserved unchanged. This combines the smoothness/reversal advantage of adaptive R with the noise-reduction/accuracy advantage of static R.
